intended_use: Validate scoped CI acceptance/evidence and retain honest all-eight accounting; preserve independent merge and readiness authority.

governance-regressions.scope: Real maintained runner negative/positive fixtures and published synthetic agent-evaluation suites; no production/provider calls.

acceptance_criteria: Declared fixture checks return actual command outcomes; failed or missing evidence cannot yield a passing result.
gaps: These tests cover known fixtures, not arbitrary repository or application behavior.
correctness.next_check: Extend acceptance fixtures for new supported project patterns.

acceptance_criteria: The runner rejects escaping paths, changed evidence, forged context and CI-only readiness promotion.
gaps: Dependency vulnerabilities, endpoint authorization and malicious-runner resistance are not established.
security.next_check: Review pinned action provenance and project-specific execution isolation.

acceptance_criteria: Timeout and failed-run recovery controls retain failure and permit a later successful fixture rerun.
gaps: Long-running concurrency, host crash and load behavior are not qualified.
reliability.next_check: Exercise concurrent/crashed workers in an isolated intended runner.

acceptance_criteria: Evidence writes preserve unowned output directories and source changes invalidate receipts.
gaps: Artifacts do not constitute an independently restored source or service backup.
data_integrity.next_check: Verify retained artifacts and restore project-specific state through the existing recovery plan.

acceptance_criteria: Failed, timed-out and missing commands remain visible in machine-readable receipts.
gaps: Alert delivery and continuous operational telemetry are not exercised.
observability.next_check: Verify a failed hosted run reaches the designated operator.

acceptance_criteria: The maintained CLI and workflow failure controls propagate rejection and preserve exact declared inputs.
gaps: Passing fixtures do not prove downstream branch protection or rollback.
delivery.next_check: Verify the exact published action revision in each required consumer job.

acceptance_criteria: An identified operator can recover and rerun intended workflows using verified retained evidence.
gaps: Operational owner acceptance, backup restoration and incident/runbook drills remain external to these tests.
operations.next_check: Establish and exercise project-specific ownership, restore and rollback procedures.

acceptance_criteria: Positive and deliberately failing synthetic controls distinguish known permitted and denied behavior.
gaps: Synthetic gate fixtures are not measured customer, production or live-agent outcomes.
outcome_evidence.next_check: Measure intended-use outcomes independently without relabeling fixtures as live evidence.
